Hi, I’m Rey Joseph “RJ” Nieto.

I am a mathematician and university instructor with a First Class Honours BSc
in Mathematics from the [University of Bristol](https://www.bristol.ac.uk/). I
currently teach mathematics and information technology at Bulacan State
University (BulSU) in the Philippines.

My technical interests include topological data analysis, applied machine
learning, and computational image analysis. Before returning to mathematics, I
worked in journalism, broadcasting, public affairs, technical writing, and
government communications.

## Research

My final-year project studied the computational stability of cubical persistent
homology in digital imaging. I derived a computable stability bound and built a
parallelised Python pipeline to investigate acquisition errors in retinal
images.

[Read the public project](https://github.com/reyjosephnieto/ph/blob/main/Nieto_TDA_Public_20260430.pdf){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
[View the repository](https://github.com/reyjosephnieto/ph){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
